divergence_justification: Intrinsic representability gap, upstream-ETL-confirmed. 430,727/431,231 rows (99.883%) identical on all representable columns. age conflicts on 460 rows (0.107%): mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_patient.sql:15 synthesises Patient.birthDate as MIN(transfers.intime)-anchor_age, not anchor_year-anchor_age; canonical age needs anchor_year, which no FHIR element carries. admittime conflicts on 44 rows (0.010%): fhir_encounter.sql:65 casts through TIMESTAMPTZ, normalising DST-gap wall times irreversibly. anchor_age/anchor_year emitted as typed NULLs per contract. Divergence propagates to creatinine_baseline, oasis, charlson, sapsii, which all select age.
